validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="s">
  <datamodel><data id="list"><a/><a/></data></datamodel>
  <state id="s">
    <onentry>
      <foreach array="$list/a" item="$it" index="$i">
        <log expr="$it"/>
        <log expr="$i"/>
      </foreach>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="f"/>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<foreach item>` names the variable `it`, which is written without `$`

primary.message: `$` is not part of the name

notes: `<foreach>` binds each item (and its position) to the variable named by `item`, declaring it when needed, and expressions then read it as `$it`; `item="$it"` is instead a location that assigns to an existing variable `$it`, and none is declared, so the loop raises `error.execution`

diagnostics.message: `<foreach index>` names the variable `i`, which is written without `$`

primary.message: `$` is not part of the name

notes: `<foreach>` binds each item (and its position) to the variable named by `index`, declaring it when needed, and expressions then read it as `$i`; `index="$i"` is instead a location that assigns to an existing variable `$i`, and none is declared, so the loop raises `error.execution`
